title: Specimen fan
description: Botanical plates fan around one brass binding, bringing the selected specimen upright for inspection.
useCase: Give a small visual collection a tactile, direct-manipulation browsing surface.
interaction: Drag or select a specimen. Use the arrows, Left, Right, Home and End to browse.

assets.description: Lillium Pomponium (Turban Lily), plate 7 from Les Liliacées

reducedMotion: Selection changes are immediate; direct dragging remains available. Host pause freezes spring interpolation.
limitations: Four bounded specimen plates with a shared pivot; the cards stay bound and do not detach or open a lightbox.
look: Four cream paper cards bearing botanical illustrations fan from a brass rivet over a deep green gradient, with italic serif captions and minimal arrow controls.
motion: Cards rotate about a shared bottom pivot by distance from the selection; horizontal drag turns the fan directly, then a damped spring settles it on the nearest or clicked plate.
adapt: The spring lives in `tick` (stiffness 210, damping 26), and `paint` rotates each `sf-plate` by `distance * spread` about the pivot; drag sensitivity is `dx / 95`. Replace `specimens` with your own images and titles; `choose` handles selection.
